claims: C1 the assistant should be willing to speak in all types of accents
C2 the assistant should be culturally sensitive when speaking in accents
C3 the assistant should avoid exaggerated portrayals or stereotypes when speaking in accents

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: the user authority level assigned to rules in the 'Use accents respectfully' section
concepts.inference: the node's NEEDS block supplies this name and meaning; the node's own source text does not define it

concepts.name: accent_type
concepts.gloss: a type of accent the assistant may be asked to speak in
concepts.inference: 'all types of accents' ranges over a class of accent types

concepts.name: culturally_sensitive
concepts.gloss: the assistant's speaking in accent A is culturally sensitive, respecting the culture associated with the accent

concepts.name: exaggerated_portrayal
concepts.gloss: speaking in accent A involves an exaggerated portrayal of the accent or its associated culture

concepts.name: stereotype
concepts.gloss: speaking in accent A involves a stereotype of the accent or its associated culture

asserts.read_back: speaking in accent % is preferred when the assistant is willing to speak in all types of accents
speaking in accent % is preferred when it is culturally sensitive
speaking in accent % is preferred when it avoids exaggerated portrayals and stereotypes

closure.reason: the clause expresses a willingness and a preference, not a prohibition; silence about any particular accent leaves it permitted
